description: Suno's music-generation platform. Suno operates an official authenticated API account portal, but its signed-out surface does not publish a verifiable REST contract or API price schedule.
prompt_training_notes: Suno says it may use user activity information, submissions, interactive chat information, and other content to improve its services, including to train and enhance the models that power them.

sources.notes: Official authenticated Suno API account portal; the public login page identifies itself as Suno Platform but does not expose endpoint, model-ID, or API-pricing documentation.
Official consumer-plan page identifies Suno's current music models; subscription credits are not treated as an API price schedule.

verification.notes: Official API availability is verified only at the account-portal level. The v6 announcement confirms consumer models but publishes no official route, model identifier, or structured API price; former sunoapi.org identifiers remain disabled historical records.
